decisions.decision: Stood guard at Bulkhead 101, leaning his massive weight against the shaking blast door to keep mutants out.
decisions.impact: Prevented door deformation from subterranean ramming attacks.

decisions.decision: Drove the final 200-pound lock-pins through the plasteel braces with his power fist under the Sarge's orders.
decisions.impact: Solidified the physical lock; Bragg proudly stamped his Aquila badge into the cooling slag.

decisions.decision: Charged shoulder-to-shoulder with the Sarge, pulping four multi-legged chitin monsters against the iron bulkheads with his power fist.
decisions.impact: Shielded the Sergeant from flanking attacks and terrified the surviving beasts into retreat.

decisions.decision: Waded waist-deep in toxic run-off to haul the iron salvage locker back to safety, growling at the dark vents.
decisions.impact: Secured the salvage point and shielded the squad from subterranean ambushes.

decisions.decision: Grappled the Great Sump Horror's scythe-jaw with his power fist, holding the thrashing monster in place while the Sarge inserted the krak grenade.
decisions.impact: Suffered acid burns on his armor but ensured the fatal strike was delivered true.

decisions.decision: Threw his colossal body in front of Sergeant Vane to take the brunt of Gorgon-Prime's acid vomit; carapace armor melted and flesh blistered.
decisions.impact: Sustained heavy 25 damage (Vitality 120 -> 95), barely remaining on his feet.

decisions.decision: Threw his colossal body in front of Sergeant Vane to take the brunt of Gorgon-Prime's acid vomit; carapace armor melted and flesh blistered.
decisions.impact: Sustained heavy 25 damage (Vitality 120 -> 95), barely remaining on his feet.

decisions.decision: Roared 'FOR DA SARGE!' and charged the titan, locking his humming Power Fist into the primary scythe-arm joint and violently ripping off an entire 8-foot talon plate before being hurled against ferrocrete.
decisions.impact: Critically fractured the beast's armor; Bragg suffered massive trauma, broken ribs, and acid burns (Vitality 70 -> 40), clinging to life.

decisions.decision: Witnessed the Sarge plunge the roaring chainsword into the monster's brain; dragged himself up with blood in his teeth, roaring with primal Ogryn triumph as the med-stims flooded his veins.
decisions.impact: Injected with 2 emergency combat med-stims; stabilized from mortal threshold (Vitality 10 -> 40), surviving as a living legend of the Astra Militarum.

decisions.decision: Helped the servitors haul massive 500-pound chitin slabs with his power fist, grinning proudly as he was awarded a roasted ten-pound marrow bone by the cooks.
decisions.impact: Vitality recovered to 60 as heavy protein and field medicae rest heal torn muscle tissues.

decisions.decision: Marched at the point of the expedition carrying the heavy field supply crate and a spare krak charge, eyes scanning the towering dark ruins for ancient traps.
decisions.impact: Shielded the expedition party as they entered the cyclopean necropolis gates; vitality restored to 70.

decisions.decision: Held his breath and moved like an iron shadow behind the Sarge, successfully bypassing a dormant Kastelan combat servitor without disturbing its auditory tripwires.
decisions.impact: Demonstrated unnatural Ogryn discipline, keeping the strike team completely undetected.

decisions.decision: Laughed with booming Ogryn joy as the 10-foot metal machine became their friend; hefted the 800-pound Sol-Aegis Plasma Reactor onto his shoulder like a sack of grain, ready to carry it back to the Sarge's base.
decisions.impact: Safely transported the archeotech core across the ancient causeway; vitality surged to 85.

decisions.decision: Marched the 800-pound Sol-Aegis Plasma Reactor safely into the Basilica transept, placed it at the foot of the golden Aquila, and stood vigilant guard outside the Sarge's quarters with humming Power Fist raised.
decisions.impact: Guaranteed total physical security for the Sergeant while she slept, proud of his service to the Emperor.

decisions.impact: Guaranteed total physical security for the Sergeant while she slept, proud of his service to the Emperor.

decisions.decision: Bellowed 'FOR DA SARGE AN' DA GOLDEN BOSS!' and charged the bone gates, slamming his overcharged Power Fist into the primary warp-pylon, dealing 246 kinetic disruption damage and toppling the entrance archway.
decisions.impact: Cleared the breach lane for the assault team (Vitality 75 -> 70).

decisions.decision: Felt the cold burn of the combat stim revitalize his heart; surged off the ground with a war-cry, locking his Power Fist around Malgakor's shin-guard and tearing off an entire ceramite greave.
decisions.impact: Stabilized from death threshold (Vitality 5 -> 30), crippling Malgakor's mobility.

decisions.decision: Roared 'NO HURT DA SARGE!' and tackled Malgakor's waist, detonating his Power Fist point-blank inside the Chaos Lord's torso before being cleaved by the descending blade.
decisions.impact: Fell in glorious combat (Vitality 5 -> 0, KIA), fracturing Malgakor's spine.

decisions.decision: Sat bolt upright in his massive stone sarcophagus roaring 'Bragg is back!', embracing Sergeant Vane and bowing before little priest Malachi.
decisions.impact: Restored to life with colossal strength and chronomantic resilience.

inventory.description: Given to Bragg by the Sergeant for bravery. Bragg polishes it every night with spit and sleeve.
inventory.name: Polished Brass Aquila Badge
